newsitem.title: USA: TRM Copy CEO Michael Simon retires.
newsitem.headline: TRM Copy CEO Michael Simon retires.

text.p: PORTLAND, Ore., Aug 19 (Rueter) - TRM Copy Centers Corp, reporting record operating income for the fourth quarter ended June 30, said Tuesday chief executive and president Michael Simon is retiring.
Fred Stockton, formerly of privately-held Estey Corp, will replace Simon effective August 25. Simon will remain a director of the company, a company statement said.

TRM's net income before extraordinary charges rose 18.8 percent to $1.5 million in the fourth quarter ended June 30, or to $0.21 a share, compared with $0.18 a share in the 1996 quarter. TRM's net sales increased 2.3 percent to $15.0 million from $14.6 million in the 1996 quarter.
But the company posted a quarterly net loss of $1.0 million, or a $0.13 a share loss, after taking a one-time accounting charge of $2.5 million, or $0.34 a share, in the quarter.
The charge related to equipment writedowns in three categories: color copiers, card printing components and older generation black and white copiers, the company said.
The company's stock dropped 1/4 to 9-3/4 Tuesday morning.
